GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 360.31 (23 Dec 45) GD
(SCAPIN - 484)
23 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Reactivation of Air Navigational Facilities.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government is hereby directed to place existing air navigational facilities between Tokyo and Kyushu in operation and thereafter operate and maintain such facilities.
2. Preliminary discussions toward this end have been undertaken by Headquarters of United States, Far East Air Forces and the Japanese Civil Aeronautics Bureau including tentative positioning of eleven beacons to be relocated on the light-line. It is desired that immediate survey be made to determine precise sites for these beacons and that a large scale map plot be submitted to Headquarters Far East Air Forces for approval prior to installation.
3. The exact date of placing the light line in operation will be coordinated with Headquarters Far East Air Forces.
4. Acknowledgement of receipt of this memorandum is directed together with an estimate of time necessary to complete the project.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
